revised_prompt:
Use case: logo-brand
Asset type: final pure raster PNG for iOS app icon and App Store icon, square 1024x1024
Primary request: Create a simpler enlarged app icon for the Chinese iOS app "步履小屋". The app turns daily walking steps into travel tickets for small animals.
Subject: One large cozy tiny cabin filling most of the icon, larger than a normal app icon illustration, with a warm lit door and simple roof. Add exactly one pair of footprint marks in the lower foreground and one clean folded paper plane, also enlarged, near the upper-right roof area or doorway. No other objects.
Style/medium: premium simplified watercolor travel-journal icon, iconic and readable, soft pencil outline, warm paper texture, crisp silhouette.
Composition/framing: all elements are noticeably larger and use the square icon space efficiently. Cabin should occupy about 75-85% of the image height/width while still safe for iOS rounded-corner crop. No tiny details. Strong readable silhouette at phone home-screen size.
Lighting/mood: warm, cozy, calm, inviting.
Color palette: warm cream background, honey yellow cabin light, warm brown roof/walls, soft muted sage/olive accent only if needed. No blue at all, no purple, no dark navy.
Materials/textures: subtle watercolor and paper grain; clean crisp edges; not blurry.
Text: no text, no letters, no numbers.
Constraints: pure image only; exactly one pair of footprints; keep one paper plane; no leaves, no flowers, no grass, no trees, no plants, no scenery, no clouds, no blue watercolor wash, no border, no exterior drop shadow, no Apple logo, no Health icon, no watermark. Must be suitable as a final phone icon and App Store icon.
